head: COP31 closes in
on a final deal
leads.deck: A new draft would acknowledge warming will pass 1.5°C; oil producers fought to keep fossil fuels out, and objections closed at 03:00 GMT.

head: Kyiv’s bridges hit
in a 400-drone night
leads.deck: 400 drones and 110 missiles in one of the war’s largest overnight attacks; three Dnipro bridges and a 750-kV substation were hit.

head: Iran strikes two
US bases in Bahrain
leads.deck: The Revolutionary Guard says it hit bases at Sheikh Isa and Al Juffair; Bahrain says the drones were intercepted. Tankers were hit in Hormuz.

cards.h: Russian cargo ship burns after a strike
cards.b: Finland says Ukraine was likely behind it; the crew reached lifeboats.

cards.h: A strike hits Zelensky’s home city
cards.b: Two people were killed, six of them children; 25 apartment blocks were damaged.
Up to 300 were aboard; 24 were rescued and needed medical care.
He is bidding for the broadest possible government.

cards.h: A strike hits a food aid vehicle
cards.b: World Central Kitchen papers were found inside the wreck.
Electricity is cut about two hours every two days as war damage bites.
The FBI had a $5m reward on the cartel boss; violence followed.

cards.h: Nvidia faces an SEC accounting probe
cards.b: The inquiry is at an early stage; weekly losses passed 20%.
The hospital says the former president is stable.
The defence minister says the budget office is wrong.

briefs.t: The FBI probes an apparent hack of its crime database.
A teen gamer helps the FBI rescue a girl online.
Vance is cornered by the midterm defeat.
Air defences down a missile.
Aoun demands a pullout from ‘every inch’.
Pezeshkian says the US wages a ‘silent economic war’.
Pugh swims the strait as a tanker is hit nearby.
A Russian drone enters its airspace twice.
Air traffic stops for the 23 November strike.
IG Metall calls out 23,000 workers on Monday.
Thousands march in Lisbon over living costs.
A Russian attaché is expelled over a murder plot.
20 to 30 Awami League homes are set on fire.
Fred Nile, a former NSW MP, dies at 92.
Bystanders pull a driver from a burning car.
Dawn Fraser marks 70 years since the 1956 Games.
The EU and Indonesia sign a deal after 10 years.
England beat New Zealand 37-12 at Twickenham.
France beat Argentina to reach the final.
Arsenal draw 2-2; Leeds win 4-1 at Chelsea.
Zverev and Alcaraz meet in today’s ATP final.
Liverpool host Manchester United at Anfield.
